description: Defines data models and query parameters for Treasury Rates, including classes for querying and representing treasury rate data with various durations.

classes.name: TreasuryRatesQueryParams
classes.description: Holds query parameters for fetching treasury rates, including optional start and end dates.

classes.name: TreasuryRatesData
classes.description: Represents treasury rate data across various durations, with fields expressed as percentages.

methods.name: TreasuryRatesQueryParams
methods.description: Constructor for query parameters, setting optional start and end dates with descriptions.

methods.name: TreasuryRatesData
methods.description: Constructor for treasury rate data, including date and various maturity rates with descriptions and JSON schema extras.
